extracted.name: Tortellini Caprese Mason Jar Salad
extracted.description: The BEST Mason Jar Salad recipes that only take 15 minutes to prep and stay good for up to 5 days! I have a BBQ Chicken Salad, Thai Salad, Greek Salad, or Tortellini Caprese Salad, and a printable with all the recipes. Say hello to your favorite meal prep lunch!
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup feta cheese crumbles (, or parmesan or mini mozzarella balls)
¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
garbanzo beans (, white or black beans)
instruction_lines: Cook tortellini according to package instructions. Drain, rinse under cold water and set aside.
Make Dressing: Add all dressing ingredients to a bowl then whisk well to combine. Taste and adjust seasonings, as desired.

Assemble: Divide dressing among the mason jars. Add onion, cherry tomatoes, tortellini, cucumber, orange bell pepper, onion and cheese. Top with lettuce-- tightly pack the jar. Add a pinch of salt and pepper and then apply mason jar lid. Refrigerate for up to 5 days.
Serve: Invert mason jar salad into a bowl, and enjoy!
